set.body:
Outcome

Provide one typed result shell for every estimand.

Acceptance

- Every requested measurement yields exactly one Success, Rejected, or Failed outcome carrying typed method data and receipt.
- Expected, visited, succeeded, rejected, failed, and stopped counts reconcile exactly.
- Streaming, visitor, fold, and collected views preserve order and identity.
- Generic metrics are derived views, never canonical scientific storage.
set.title: P2.5: implement total AnalysisResult and MeasurementOutcome
